remarks: Bright and freshly painted 2-bedroom condo in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This remodeled Unit 3R offers an updated kitchen and bath, great natural light, ample closet space, and a well-designed layout ideal for comfortable living. The unit also includes a dedicated storage room, ideal for seasonal items, bikes, or additional belongings. Coin-operated laundry is conveniently located in the building. Enjoy unbeatable access to restaurants, cafes, shopping, nightlife, and public transportation, including easy access to Stamford's free trolley connecting Downtown, the train station, and Harbor Point. Parking is available for rent nearby. A fantastic opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods. $100.00 move-in and move-out fees apply.
